uncited: This family encompasses techniques that optimize the computational cost of ray-grid traversal and determine optimal data structure parameters for volume rendering .
It addresses the bottleneck of redundant voxel or primitive evaluations along a ray by focusing on execution efficiency and resolution tuning rather than defining new traversal algorithms .
Unlike sibling methods that specify traversal order or coherence exploitation, this family optimizes the cost of executing traversal and the parameters under which it runs .
All methods in this family build on [Ray-grid traversal](17-ray-grid-traversal.md), which advances analytically from one cell boundary to the next .
The core mechanism determines the next cell by comparing distances to upcoming boundaries on the x, y, and z axes, selecting the minimum distance to advance .
Optimization and cost models do not alter this fundamental geometric logic but instead optimize the *cost* of executing it or the *parameters* (like grid resolution) under which it runs .
